capabilities: Insert a live table of contents block via command or code block
Limit included headings with a configurable max level per block or globally
Show the TOC with page numbers and dot leaders in Pagina PDF exports
Set page breaks before or after the TOC block in PDFs
Save and restore plugin settings as a JSON file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation covers block options and settings but no troubleshooting or limits.
problem: Obsidian's outline lives in a sidebar, so notes have no built-in way to embed a table of contents inside the note body that updates as headings change.

relations.evidence: The same block can appear in a Pagina PDF.
Its title is not numbered by Ordinal Headings.

summary: In-note table of contents plugin that renders a live, linked TOC from a code block and adds page-numbered entries in Pagina PDF exports.
